summary: Gone fire tower on County 13 east of Lawler, Aitkin County; a 1969 USGS map labels it, and a modern communication tower now occupies the old site.

facts.status_note: The old lookout no longer stands. A modern communication tower has replaced it on the site, per kjackson.us.

notes_for_editor: Build date, builder, height, design and staffing are not in any source read; the A-Z list gives only the name, county and location. Gone status is supported by the Forest Fire Lookout Association index and the A-Z wording. Coordinates match both lists (brief 46.53395, -93.13149; A-Z 46.5339, -93.1314). The 1918 fire paragraph is about the village, not the lookout; no source ties the tower to that fire, so the story keeps it as village context only. The 1918 date and the fire's effects are checked against the kjackson.us page. The kjackson.us page has photos with captions, but no image URLs were retrieved, so no photos are added. The kjackson.us page is the only source on the site today, and it gives no access information. Two web searches used.
